messages.snippet: A reminder that the technology group's CPD seminar on AI clauses and UK GDPR in commercial contracts
messages.subject: CPD seminar: AI and data protection in commercial contracts – 19 Nov
messages.plaintextBody:
A reminder that the technology group's CPD seminar on AI clauses and UK GDPR in commercial contracts takes place at 12:30 on 19 November in the 8th-floor seminar room (lunch provided). 1.5 CPD hours. Please reply to reserve a place.

Donna Bridges
Practice Assistant
